recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the OpenAPI generator regresses or needs new behavior, file and fix it in org.hl7.fhir.core or HL7/fhir-ig-publisher rather than in the FHIR spec source tree.
issue_request: FHIR-22825 asked that IG Publisher OpenAPI generation stop outputting STU3 JSON schema references when generating from an R4 CapabilityStatement; Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution and a fixed comment.
initial_application: No current HL7/fhir commit was found with the issue key. The active OpenAPI generator had moved to org.hl7.fhir.core before the issue, and external commit cc837365 changed specRef from hard-coded STU3 to context-version logic that maps 4.0.x to the R4 schema base.
additional_context: The current HL7/fhir checkout has no active OpenAPI generator source and only one active narrative OpenAPI mention. Current HL7/fhir-ig-publisher invokes org.hl7.fhir.r5.openapi.OpenApiGenerator from the external core library, and the current external implementation maps R4 contexts to https://hl7.org/fhir/R4. Zulip confirms the exact R4/STU3 problem and fix acknowledgement; Confluence searches found no contrary record.
reconciliation: No source change was made in HL7/fhir. The issue is reconciled with an empty external-repo audit commit because the relevant implementation is external to this checkout and current FHIR source has no in-scope artifact to edit.
